metrics.okHint: Orders with Tool result note = 'ok' (checked, no error)
metrics.unreviewedHint: Orders with an empty Tool result note (not checked yet)
metrics.toolErrorHint: Total orders EVER flagged with an error during tool check (reviewer set Note ≠ 'ok') — historical count, does NOT decrease once fixed; excludes orders sent back by Print for re-check
metrics.wasOkPushedHint: Orders that were NEVER a tool-check error (ok/unreviewed) but got sent back to the designer by a later stage — historical count, doesn't decrease once fixed (includes unclaimed sent-back orders)
metrics.unassignedNeedHint: Orders CURRENTLY in error (Tool result note has a value ≠ 'ok') that need a designer but are NOT assigned. Cross-check: Tool check error + OK/unreviewed sent back = Assigned + Unassigned + resolved-without-designer (last tooltip row).
metrics.assignedHint: Total orders HANDED to a designer (any status) — matches the 'Total / day' row of the 'All designers by day' table. Comes from 2 sources: tool-check errors + ok/unreviewed orders sent back by a stage.
metrics.designDoneHint: Orders the designer has COMPLETED (designerStatus = done) — matches the 'Done' column of the 'All designers by day' table. A subset of the Assigned row.
metrics.totalErrorHint: = Tool check error + OK/unreviewed → sent back (2 non-overlapping sources) — total orders that ever needed a designer due to an error, historical. Cross-check: = Assigned + Unassigned + resolved-without-designer.
metrics.backlogSubtitle: unreviewed + assigned-not-done + unassigned · click to view by designer
